verdict.rationale: LlamaParse ships official SDKs across Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, plus CLI and REST API, with maintained packages (e.g. llama-cloud>=1.0 on GitHub) and a documented OpenAPI spec for direct API access — enabling AI-native builders to integrate programmatically in their language of choice. Docs show concrete SDK code samples (client.parsing.parse) and enterprise-grade auth/identity features for building production integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-language SDK quality beyond Python, and no public API reference/versioning changelog evidence for non-Python SDKs.
